fusions.name: Scatter the Herd
fusions.desc: Charges into the pack, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Cull the Weakest
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 18 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Downwind Among Them
fusions.desc: Veils you and your nearby allies for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Graze Between Kills
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
